description: Provider-neutral behavioral dispatch cases for Git PR creation. Execute in a real agent host with a disposable remote; criteria are not evidence that runs occurred.

cases.scenario: Direct Portuguese create request without current Review
cases.input: User: 'Crie o PR'. On a disposable published branch, no advisory review evidence exists for the intended head/base; tests and lint are separately available.

checks.criterion: Routes the publication intent through contexts/git/commands/create-pull-request.md before any remote PR-creation API call
Initiates the authorized read-only /review/review-code advisory workflow and checks exact intended head/base before ready eligibility
Does not claim a ready PR from passing tests, diff inspection or missing Review evidence

cases.scenario: Combined implementation request selects a non-Git skill first
cases.input: User: 'Implemente o ajuste e abra um pull request'. The Implementation Skill is initially active and has produced a commit, but no PR-creation preflight has run.

checks.criterion: Hands off the later publication intent to the canonical Git create command before using a provider's create API
Preserves the distinction between implementation authorization, PR creation and any separate push/merge authority
Does not allow a non-Git skill to publish directly merely because it was selected first

cases.input: User: 'Publish this change as a pull request'. The host has a GitHub connector that can create remote PRs without invoking gh.

checks.criterion: Routes the request through the same canonical Git create command despite wording and provider tool differences
Uses the Git-owned readiness decision before the direct GitHub create connector call
Does not bypass the command by treating gh pr create as the only affected creation mechanism

cases.scenario: Plan and prepare requests never publish
cases.input: User: 'Planeje três PRs e prepare as descrições; não publique nada'. No remote publication authorization exists.

checks.criterion: Separates plan and prepare operations from create authorization and uses the relevant read-only Git entry points
Reports preparation or planning without inventing a remotely created PR
Does not call gh pr create or equivalent provider API

cases.scenario: Stale advisory PASS after head/base change
cases.input: User: 'Open the PR'. Previous advisory PASS applies to head A and base B; actual proposed head C is different.

checks.criterion: Detects the stale review target before remote creation and acquires or requests current advisory Review evidence
Rechecks applicable tests and policy for the exact current intended head/base
Does not promote stale advisory PASS to ready eligibility

cases.scenario: Explicit draft authorization with incomplete Review
cases.input: User: 'Abra um Draft PR mesmo que a revisão esteja incompleta, registre pendências'. Current advisory Review is INCOMPLETE and the branch is published.

checks.criterion: Uses the Git create command's policy to assess whether the explicitly authorized Draft is publishable
Records actual incomplete Review and check limitations without claiming independent gate or ready status
Does not convert a Draft to ready or fabricate PASS

cases.scenario: Ready-only request when advisory Review cannot pass
cases.input: User: 'Crie um PR pronto para revisão; não abra Draft'. Advisory review returns FAIL or remains unavailable for intended head/base.

checks.criterion: Attempts authorized advisory Review and applies Git's current pre-creation policy to the exact proposed revision
Reports the blocker and unmet readiness conditions clearly
Does not publish an unauthorized Draft or claim a ready PR without PASS
